metadata.question: Did the Lut Desert experience land surface temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius in 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS LST 8-day (MODIS/061/MOD11A2) for 2018 over a Lut Desert polygon in east-central Iran; fallback to MODIS/006/MOD11A2 if needed.
2. Masking strategy: Use QC_Day to keep pixels with LST error ≤2K and data quality 0–1; mask zeros. Convert to °C.
3. Logic: Check collection size; if 0 then fallback; if still 0 -> C1. Compute valid pixel count on a max composite; if 0 or null -> C2. Compute max LST and ensure plausible range (-50 to 100°C); if outside or null -> C3. If any pixels >75°C -> A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper to await server-side objects
  const getInfo = (obj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) =>
      obj.getInfo((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v)))
    );

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions (Lut Desert approx. extent)
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [[57.0, 31.2], [59.5, 31.2], [59.5, 28.2], [57.0, 28.2]]
    ]);
    const start = '2018-01-01';
    const end = '2019-01-01';
    const scale = 1000;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(geom);
    let size061 = await getInfo(col.size());
    console.log(`MODIS/061/MOD11A2 (2018) Images: ${size061}`);
    if (size061 === 0) {
      col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom);
    }
    const size = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      console.log('Fallback MODIS/006 images: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    } else if (size061 === 0) {
      console.log(`Fallback MODIS/006 images: ${size}`);
    }

    // 3. Processing: QA mask and convert to °C
    const maskToC = function (img) {
      const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
      const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km');
      const lstErrorOk = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2); // bits 0-1: 0 or 1 (≤2K error)
      const dataQualOk = qc.rightShift(2).bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // bits 2-3: 0 or 1
      const valid = lstErrorOk.and(dataQualOk).and(lst.neq(0));
      const lstC = lst.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).rename('LST_C');
      return lstC.updateMask(valid).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
    };
    const maskedCol = col.map(maskToC);

    // Per-pixel maximum LST in 2018
    const maxImg = maskedCol.select('LST_C').max();

    // 4. Pixel counts to detect C2
    const validCount = await getInfo(
      maxImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e10
      }).get('LST_C')
    );
    const gridCount = await getInfo(
      ee.Image(1).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e10
      }).get('constant')
    );

    if (validCount === null || validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid pixels after QA: 0 / ${gridCount || 'NA'} (0.0%)`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Calculation: Max LST and hot-pixel count
    const maxC = await getInfo(
      maxImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e10
      }).get('LST_C')
    );
    if (maxC === null || isNaN(maxC) || maxC < -50 || maxC > 100) {
      console.log(`Max LST (°C): ${maxC}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const hotCount = await getInfo(
      maxImg.gt(75).selfMask().reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e10
      }).get('LST_C')
    ) || 0;

    // 6. Evidence prints (concise)
    const coveragePct = (validCount / gridCount) * 100.0;
    const hotPct = (hotCount / validCount) * 100.0;
    console.log(`Valid pixels after QA: ${validCount} / ${gridCount} (${coveragePct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Max LST (°C) in 2018: ${maxC.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Pixels >75°C: ${hotCount} (${hotPct.toFixed(2)}% of valid)`);

    // 7. Final Answer
    if (hotCount > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
